title: When the Tryouts Breaks
author: Yara Quintana
blurb: Lior Eastwick, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before graduation.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
